patch_summary: This packet has two bounded defects. First, true leaf positions using an Instrument hierarchy marker were filtered as aggregate rows; pipeline/bdc_identifier.py now treats Instrument like Investment Type only when loan/equity terms and rate or maturity evidence are also present. Second, source-only aggregate labels ending in '% of Net Assets' were classified as leaf parser mismatches; pipeline/source_reconciliation.py now treats those terminal percentage labels as terminal pct rows and documents exact Investments/Cash and Investments totals as non-position rows unless leaf-position evidence is present.
primary_justification: Manual bundle review shows the packet is mixed. The high-FV labels Cash and Investments - 166.1% of Net Assets, Debt Investments - 159.7% of Net Assets, and Investments - 159.8% of Net Assets have no issuer, instrument, rate, maturity, principal, or share evidence and are aggregate portfolio labels. Other rows in the same packet, such as Discovery Purchaser Corporation, Olympus Water, and Brand safway, have coordinate-level source-table evidence as real current-period loan positions. A bounded patch can therefore distinguish aggregate labels from real Instrument leaf rows without converting aggregate/header/subtotal rows into production positions.
residual_risk: The source reconciliation impact must be confirmed by a clean rebuild, because this verdict covers a mixed packet and the current output artifacts predate the two production patches. The false-positive tests constrain both sides: bare Instrument labels remain aggregate, singular Investment geography rollups remain category rollups, and leaf rows with issuer/instrument/rate/maturity evidence remain blocking until parsed.
